transformation: Source JPEGs copied without re-encoding, cropping or generation
approvalBoundary: No trademark clearance, licensing decision, final brand approval or public-asset approval is implied

assets.fit: Contain in a square frame; cropping risks cutting the wordmark near the lower edge
assets.surfaceReview: Orange wordmark reads on both specimens; dark navy linework is weak on dark surfaces and the black field is a hard rectangle on light surfaces
assets.responsiveReview: Keep square and avoid narrow logo lockups; do not use as a tiny favicon or text replacement
assets.altText: NEKURAMA cat illustration with orange wordmark on a black background, candidate asset

assets.background: Opaque checkerboard pattern baked into JPEG; not transparency
assets.fit: Contain only for review; cropping makes the already-baked checkerboard read as an intentional border
assets.surfaceReview: Checkerboard remains visible on light and dark surfaces and competes with the mark; unsuitable as a transparent logo without a new approved source
assets.responsiveReview: Avoid small responsive placements because the checkerboard pattern becomes visual noise
assets.altText: NEKURAMA winged cat illustration and wordmark over a visible checkerboard background, candidate asset

assets.fit: Contain in a square specimen or dark card; cropping risks cutting the character, bulb and wordmark
assets.surfaceReview: Character and light wordmark contrast well against light surfaces, while the black field blends into dark surfaces and hides its edge
assets.responsiveReview: Use as a contained internal hero/brand specimen, not as a flexible wordmark or small navigation mark
assets.altText: BABAI character with laptop, light bulb and wordmark on a black background, candidate asset

assets.fit: Contain only; the low-contrast linework becomes indistinct when cropped or reduced
assets.surfaceReview: Very dark linework fails on dark surfaces; the small yellow keyhole is the only strong accent and cannot carry the whole mark
assets.responsiveReview: Not suitable for small responsive logo use without an approved high-contrast source
assets.altText: Minimal NEKURAMA cat and wordmark with a yellow keyhole pendant on a black background, candidate asset

assets.fit: Contain in a square frame; cropping risks cutting the wing tips or wordmark
assets.surfaceReview: Orange wordmark has useful contrast on both specimens, but the dark illustration loses detail on dark surfaces and the black field is not transparent
assets.responsiveReview: Use only as a contained candidate specimen; do not let object-fit cover turn it into a cropped logo
assets.altText: NEKURAMA winged cat illustration with orange wordmark on a black background, candidate asset

generatedAssets.intent: Friendly mascot plus AI spark/light cue; exploratory product mark only
generatedAssets.altText: Candidate BABAI mascot mark with an orange AI spark, transparent SVG concept
generatedAssets.usage: Prefer cream or deep-green surfaces; preserve square viewBox and full spark/ear silhouette. Use as a contained mark, not a cropped wordmark.
generatedAssets.contrast: Deep green and cream pass WCAG AA on the tested light/dark specimens; orange is an accent and must not carry small text.

generatedAssets.intent: Restaurant operator/service badge plus secondary AI spark cue; exploratory product mark only

generatedAssets.contrast: Deep green and cream pass WCAG AA on the tested light/dark specimens; orange and yellow are display accents only.

generatedAssets.contrast: Cream on deep green and deep green on cream pass WCAG AA for the wordmark; orange/yellow remain non-text accents.
